_about: Batch B11 (start-up tour, config.py, environ.py, stats_logger.py, reference pages config-classes, cpp-engine-api, faq). Owner: B11 writer.

engine-args.short: The dataclass with all engine settings. LLM passes its keyword arguments to it. create_engine_configs() turns it into the four config objects.
engine-args.long: Defined in {{cite deepinfer/engine/arg_utils.py:17-46}}. Its defaults differ from the defaults of LLM for some fields.

engine-configs.short: The four objects ModelConfig, CacheConfig, ParallelConfig and SchedulerConfig. The engine, the workers and the C++ scheduler read their settings from them.
engine-configs.long: All four are defined in {{cite deepinfer/config.py:19-216}}.

runtime-max-model-len.short: max_model_len plus room for draft tokens and in-flight tokens. It is the upper limit of every position at run time: 32768 becomes 32784 with nextn 5 and ZOS on.

gpu-memory-utilization.short: The fraction of the total device memory that the engine may use for weights, activations and the KV cache. The default is 0.9.

spawn.short: A multiprocessing start method. The child process is a new Python interpreter: it imports all modules again and gets a copy of the environment variables.

rendezvous.short: The first meeting of all ranks. Each rank connects to one TCP address, gets its place in the world group, and only then can collectives run.

mfu.short: Model FLOPs utilization: the floating-point operations per second that the model really does, divided by the peak of the hardware. 1.0 is the peak.

stats-window.short: A list of per-step records that the statistics logger keeps for the last N steps. Throughput, accept rates and moe_lb are sums over this list.

profiler-trace.short: A JSON file in Chrome trace format that torch.profiler writes. It shows the CPU functions and device kernels of some steps on a timeline.
